summary: Jianming Hu works in Buddhist studies. He studied at Waseda University (attested 2015) and held a researcher post at Komazawa University (attested 2015).

Jien Abe (1937–2001) was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology. He studied as a graduate student at the University of Tokyo (attested 1973) and served as a professor at Meiji University until 2001.
Jigmeth Junu is a scholar in Buddhist studies. He earned an MA at Fo Guang University under MA supervisor Yongdong Shi and studied under traditional teacher Hui Xian (both attested 2013).
Jikai Fujiyoshi (1915–1996) specialized in Buddhist studies. He served as a professor at Rissho University and was a member at Kyoto University (attested 1967).

Jikido Takasaki (1926–2013) was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology. He completed PhDs at Savitribai Phule Pune University and the University of Tokyo, later serving as professor at the University of Tokyo and president of Tsurumi University (1992–2004).
Jim G. Shaffer (born 1944) works in history, archaeology, and Indology. He completed his studies at Arizona State University (~1964–1968) and the University of Wisconsin–Madison (~1968–1972).

Jim Rheingans specializes in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He completed an MA at the University of Hamburg and earned a PhD from the University of the West of England (by 2008) and Bath Spa University, supervised by David P. Jackson.

Jim Taylor works in religious studies and Buddhist studies. He earned his PhD at Macquarie University by 1989 and served as Senior Lecturer in Anthropology at the University of Adelaide (attested 2014).

Jin Y. Park specializes in philosophy, Buddhist studies, and religious studies. She served as Assistant Professor of Philosophy and Religion at American University (attested 2007–2012) and as a visiting fellow at City University of Hong Kong.

Jinah Kim works in history, archaeology, Indology, and Buddhist studies. She earned her PhD at the University of California, Berkeley under Joanna Gottfried Williams, was a Mellon fellow at the Institute for Advanced Study, and joined Harvard University.

Jinbo Shi (born 1940) specializes in Sinology, linguistics, and Tibetology. He studied at Minzu University of China (~1958–1962) and held appointments at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences and its Institute of Ethnology and Anthropology (~1977).
Jinchuan Wan is a scholar of Buddhist studies and philosophy. He held posts as professor at both National Central University and Fo Guang University (both attested 2010).
Jing Yin specializes in Buddhist studies. A former student of K. L. Dhammajoti (attested 1995), Jing Yin served as Director at the University of Hong Kong (attested 2006–2010).

Jing-shen Tao (born 1933) is a historian and Sinologist. He studied at National Taiwan University and Indiana University, served as Professor of East Asian Studies at the University of Arizona (~1976–1998), and was a fellow at Academia Sinica.
Jingkong (1927–2022) was a figure in Buddhist studies. He studied under Thomé H. Fang (~1952–1955) and Bingnan Li (~1958–1968).

Jinhua Chen specializes in Buddhist studies and Sinology. He completed graduate studies at McMaster University, postdoctoral research at Kyoto University under Noritoshi Aramaki, and served as professor of East Asian Buddhism at the University of British Columbia (attested 2008–2018).

Jinhua Jia works in Sinology, religious studies, and Buddhist studies. She earned her PhD at the University of Colorado Boulder under Paul W. Kroll, and held posts at Harvard University, City University of Hong Kong, and Hong Kong Polytechnic University.
Jinling He specializes in Buddhist studies. She completed a Master of Arts degree at Fo Guang University under the supervision of Koki Okumura.
Jinping Liao is a scholar in Buddhist studies. Liao completed a Master of Arts at Fo Guang University under the supervision of Kirill Jurievitch Solonin (attested 2009).

Jinshi Fan (born 1938) specializes in archaeology and Buddhist studies. She studied at Peking University (~1958–1963) and later served as Director of the Dunhuang Academy (~1998–2014) as well as holding a post at Lanzhou University.
